sections.label: Site
sections.description: How search engines see this environment.

fields.name: siteName
fields.label: Site name
fields.description: og:site_name and the schema.org WebSite and Organization names on every market. Empty: each market uses its own name. A name for one market goes under Markets.

options.label: Automatic — only when the environment type is production

fields.name: environment
fields.label: Environment type
fields.description: What automatic indexing reads. Empty: the NUXT_SITE_ENV, NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_ENV or VERCEL_ENV variable, else production.

fields.name: includeImages
fields.label: List preview images
fields.description: An image entry for each page-index entry that carries a preview image.

fields.name: defaultChangefreq
fields.label: Default change frequency
fields.description: For a URL that sets none. Empty: no changefreq.

fields.name: defaultPriority
fields.label: Default priority
fields.description: From 0 to 1, for a URL that sets none. Empty: no priority.

fields.name: excludePageTypes
fields.label: Page types left out
fields.description: A JSON list of page type tokens. Their pages get no URL and no child sitemap.

fields.name: pageTypes
fields.label: Change frequency and priority per page type
fields.description: A JSON list, one entry per page type.

fields.name: blockNonSeoBots
fields.label: Block crawlers that are not search engines

fields.name: localizeRules
fields.label: Repeat each rule under the language prefixes of the host
fields.description: Disallow: /login then also covers /en/login on a host that serves English under /en.

fields.name: extraDisallow
fields.label: More Disallow paths
fields.description: A JSON list of paths, added to the * group.

fields.name: customGroups
fields.label: More User-agent groups
fields.description: A JSON list of groups, each with userAgent, allow, disallow, contentUsage and contentSignal.

schema.label: AI preferences
schema.description: What a crawler may do with what it fetched, for the * group. Empty keeps the defaults shown, which leave AI training unstated. [] states nothing.

fields.name: contentUsage
fields.label: Content-Usage
fields.description: Categories bots, train-ai, ai-output, search. Values y, n.

fields.name: contentSignal
fields.label: Content-Signal
fields.description: Categories search, ai-input, ai-train. Values yes, no.

sections.label: Open Graph
sections.description: The og: tags a shared link shows.

fields.name: defaultType
fields.label: Default og:type
fields.description: For every page type without its own.

fields.name: pageTypes
fields.label: og:type per page type
fields.description: A JSON object keyed by page type token. It is merged over blog/post-single → article, ecommerce/product-detail-page → product and location/detail → place.

sections.label: AI agents
sections.description: Markdown twins of every page, and /llms.txt.

fields.name: contentNegotiation
fields.label: Send a request that prefers Markdown to the twin
fields.description: Accept: text/markdown, or a known AI agent, gets a 307 to the .md URL.

fields.name: describedby
fields.label: Link /llms.txt in the page head and the Link header

fields.name: mdreamOptions
fields.label: Markdown conversion
fields.description: mdream options as a JSON object, merged over this app's own. A list is added to, not replaced.

fields.name: markdownLinks
fields.label: Link pages to their Markdown twin

fields.name: sections
fields.label: Sections
fields.description: A JSON list of sections, each with title, description, links and optional.

fields.name: pageTypes
fields.label: Page types
fields.description: Title and description per page type token, as a JSON object. false leaves a page type out.

sections.label: Structured data
sections.description: The schema.org graph of every page: WebSite, WebPage and, when set, the organization behind the site.

fields.name: organization
fields.label: Organization
fields.description: Empty: the graph has no Organization node. Values that differ per market go under Markets.

fields.name: type
fields.label: Type
fields.description: Empty: Organization.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Empty: the site name of each host.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: A path or an absolute URL. Google asks for at least 112 × 112 pixels.

fields.name: sameAs
fields.label: Profiles elsewhere
fields.description: A JSON list of URLs.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Postal address
fields.description: Fill street, postal code, city and country, or none of them. An address without one of them stops the build.

fields.name: addressCountry
fields.label: Country
fields.description: A two-letter code.

sections.label: Markets
sections.description: Values that differ between the shops of this project.

fields.name: markets
fields.label: Per market
fields.description: A JSON object keyed by market id, which stays when a market is renamed. Each value replaces the project-wide one on the market's hosts. An organization's address and sameAs are replaced whole.
